comment: The dataset's own DOI URL -> PropertyValue (propertyID doi). Replaces the Croissant pass, which takes the first DOI it finds in citeAs -- in FAIR² that is the data article's.
FAIR² uses schema:dateUpdated for the last change to the dataset; CDIF requires schema:dateModified. Without it the Croissant pass falls back to datePublished.
Copied as is.

Ordered list of Person/Organization with identifier (ORCID/ROR) and affiliation, which the Croissant pass drops. FAIR² AuthorRole (e.g. Corresponding Author) on a creator has no CDIF slot on schema:creator and is not carried.
One schema:Role per (contributor, prov:hadRole) pair; roleName is a DefinedTerm with the CRediT/CRO label and its IRI.
Each Grant -> schema:MonetaryGrant with name, identifier, url and every funder. The Croissant pass keeps only the first grant and drops funders.
Nested containsPlace hierarchy (bounding box > hull > sampling sites) flattened to a list of schema:Place, keeping name, description, identifier and geo (GeoShape box/polygon or GeoCoordinates).
ISO 8601 interval string, carried as is.
FAIR² access agreement level (a DefinedTerm) -> '<name>: <definition>' statement plus the level's URL. The usage note (skos:note) is not carried.

The peer DataArticle node -> LinkRole (linkRelationship 'dataArticle') targeting the article URL, with its name. OPEN QUESTION: a controlled relation term (e.g. DataCite IsDescribedBy) instead of the FAIR² property name.
-> LinkRole (linkRelationship 'citation'). Skipped when it is the same URL as dataArticle, which it usually is.
The peer DataArchive node (long-term copy, e.g. Zenodo) -> LinkRole (linkRelationship 'dataArchive') with the archive name and holding archive. OPEN QUESTION: as for dataArticle.

Each DataPortal (a versioned, authored web portal for the dataset, fair2:DataPortal subClassOf schema:CreativeWork) -> LinkRole (linkRelationship 'dataPortal') whose target is typed [schema:EntryPoint, schema:CreativeWork] and carries the portal's name, description, identifier, version and authors. CDIF's linkRole block requires the EntryPoint type and leaves the target open.
Subject domain (e.g. a Wikidata concept) -> schema:DefinedTerm keyword with name and IRI, added to the Croissant keywords.

Each method Section -> [prov:Activity, schema:Action] with schema:actionProcess HowTo; Steps -> HowToStep with position (fair2:next order); Substeps -> HowToDirection itemListElement; prov:used -> the referenced documents/software; fair2:generated -> schema:result variable references. Follows the CDIF provenance building block. The provenance profile is declared only when every activity names its inputs (prov:used), which CDIF requires; a FAIR² section that lists none keeps the record at core/discovery/data_description.

Each changelog entry (a schema:UpdateAction) -> a [prov:Activity, schema:Action] with additionalType schema:UpdateAction: name from the version it produced (or its date), endTime = datePublished, actionStatus completed, description from newFeatures / improvements / bugFixes / otherInformation (or the prose description), prov:used = the version it revised (wasRevisionOf). A first release names no earlier version and so has no prov:used. Some entries record metadata-only fixes; they are not separated, since telling them apart would mean reading free text.

FAIR² points subjectOf at the FAIR² specification the metadata follows; in CDIF that is a conformsTo claim on the catalog record. Kept beside the detected cdif: profiles.
Dataset-level contentUrl names the fair2.json file itself (e.g. 'fair2.json'); not a distribution of the data, so not carried.
_meta.conformsTo: the FAIR² spec version the file was written against -> a conformsTo claim on the catalog record.
_meta.dateModified: last change to the metadata file -> catalog record dateModified.
_meta.dateCreated -> catalog record dateCreated.
_meta.version: version of the metadata file (not the dataset) -> catalog record version.
